evidence_excerpts: Using b/a = 1.4, we chose a nominal threshold of 0.35x and 0.85x for two-input OR and AND gate, respectively, and 0.4x and 1.6x for three-input OR and AND gate. Experiments of the logic gates showed desired behaviours.
text: Effective concentration calibration provides quantitative threshold choices that restore desired OR and AND gate behavior for unpurified seesaw components.
